thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: org=sierra-logistics (org_id:sierra-322) spike detected — sustained 6xx rate increase, tail latency > 2s across generator endpoints. Severity: P1. Pager sent to #incidents and @evan_sre :rotating_light:

evAN_sre: acked. jumping in. seeing errors from streaming/generate and embedding-create.

evAN_sre: external dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/orgs/sierra-322?panel=latency (high) :eyes:

maria_support: Sierra CS reported degraded user experience ~10:12 UTC. They claim an internal job started looping after deploy at 09:58.

jamie_oncall: @evan_sre - i'm on handoff in 10, can we get a quick mitigation plan?

evAN_sre: plan: 1) put org into emergency limited-mode (soft-throttle) to preserve platform for others, 2) unblock customer quick path if they ask for increased capacity, 3) escalate to infra if system-level issue. executing step 1 now.

sachin_infra: recommended: apply a per-org `burst_window` shrink + lower `max_rps` and enable `queue_drop=true` for this org. I'll prepare the admin call.

kelsea_prodeng: FYI this org is on dedicated contract; ops prefers `graceful-throttle` rather than hard cutoff unless CS confirms they want lower availability.

maria_support: Sierra CS says they need at least minimal throughput for critical invoices. we should offer temporary higher commit if we can throttle background jobs.

evAN_sre: running admin override now — putting org into emergency throttle mode (reduce max_rps to 8, burst=20 tokens, queue_limit=30).

evAN_sre: /admin tool call:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/orgs/sierra-322/overrides" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"reason":"auto-mitigation spike 1977654321","overrides":{"max_rps":8,"burst_tokens":20,"queue_limit":30,"soft_mode":true},"expires_in":"30m"}'
```

incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED: override_id=ovr-9876, expires=30m, triggered_by=evan_sre.

jamie_oncall: :thumbsup: evan — set a watch on error rate and tail latency. i'll take on monitoring and customer comms.

maria_support: I told Sierra CS we've limited noisy background jobs and asked them to pause the job if possible. they replied: "we can pause, but need some invoices processed now" — asking for temporary priority path for the webhook/invoice route.

evAN_sre: created a temporary route rule to prioritize `/v1/generate/invoice` by assigning it to a high-priority queue with token cap 50/min (to allow critical flows but limit blast radius). admin call:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/orgs/sierra-322/routes" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate/invoice","priority":"high","rate_limit":{"per_minute":50}}'
```

sachin_infra: also pushed a config to edge for `disable_feature=inline-embeddings` for that org to avoid heavy calls spiking GPU. command: `infractl org-config set sierra-322 disable_inline_embeddings=true`

maria_support: CS updated: pausing background job now, trying critical path. they're seeing some successes but still intermittent 502s.

jamie_oncall: Observability: datadog query: `avg:last_5m(request.duration){org:sierra-322}` shows tail dropping from 2.3s -> 1.1s after throttle. errors down 60% in last 8m. :chart_with_downwards_trend: 

evAN_sre: good. leaving override in place, extend if needed. i'll annotate incident and hand to @jamie_oncall for watch. evan out in 5.

incident-bot: HANDOFF: oncall=jAMIE_ONCALL, original_pager=evan_sre, handoff_ts=1977654680.

jamie_oncall: taking it. i'll keep 15m checks and will escalate to infra if errors plateau. @maria_support please hold CS update: we offered two choices — (A) keep throttles and pause job, (B) we can temporarily bump dedicated commit after a brief review (requires sales/finance OK).

maria_support: noted. CS prefers A for now. they're going to run through remaining payments.

kelsea_prodeng: follow-up item: we should add a canned runbook for `emergency-org-soft-throttle` with CLI commands and an automatic telemetry dashboard. filing ticket RN.

evAN_sre: post-incident checklist: 1) review why job looped (CS log), 2) evaluate if we need per-route default priorities, 3) check billing implications for dedicated customers when we throttle.

jamie_oncall: current status: override in place, route priority added, feature disabled, customer paused background job. monitoring shows errors trending down. keeping incident open for 45m until override expires.

maria_support: CS says gratitude and will follow up with logs. adding support ticket id: SUP-2026-1144.

incident-bot: REMINDER: override ovr-9876 expires in 10m unless extended.

jamie_oncall: extending override 30m to let CS finish critical flows. running extension:
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/overrides/ovr-9876" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"expires_in":"30m","notes":"extension for CS critical flows"}'
```

incident-bot: OVERRIDE UPDATED: ovr-9876 expires in 30m. updated_by=jamie_oncall.

jamie_oncall: leaving note: after incident close -> owner=prodeng (kelsea_prodeng) for runbook + postmortem.

sachin_infra: recommend a perf-test for invoice route under realistic job load and consider defaulting heavy endpoints to token-metered plans.

maria_support: closing loop: CS will send job logs and will coordinate if they want us to reverse disable_feature later.

jamie_oncall: incident will remain OPEN. monitoring checks every 10m. will post update on closure and link to postmortem and support ticket. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: THREAD SUMMARY: mitigation=soft-throttle + per-route priority + disable_feature; override_id=ovr-9876; ticket=SUP-2026-1144; handoff_to=jamie_oncall.
